arguments.content:
# Linux playback smoke: fixture media under /opt/nothingness/media
# Exercise play/pause, seek (fast-forward), and next/prev (skip).
call ext.nothingness.setQueue paths=/opt/nothingness/media/01-undercover-49.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/02-undercover-50.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/03-undercover-51.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/04-undercover-52.opus startIndex=0
inspect
# pause/resume (transport)
pause
inspect
resume
inspect
# fast-forward within the current track
seek 0:45
inspect
# skip forward/back
next
inspect
prev
inspect
# One more seek after hop
seek 0:20
inspect
